paper_title: A multi-classifier system integrated by clinico-histology-genomic analysis for predicting recurrence of papillary renal cell carcinoma
prediction_task: pRCC recurrence prediction from lncRNA + histopathology WSI + clinicopathological features

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: What is the added novelty compared to the previous study on ccRCC? Why use lncRNA but not mRNA or other molecular features? Would integration of mRNA/miRNA/methylation result in better predictions?
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Discussed pRCC-specific biology and added mRNA comparison showing lncRNA provides unique prognostic information.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Data inconsistencies: why different cutoff from training set applied to validation but different median for TCGA? P-value is 0.004 or 0.042, not <0.001 as stated. Number at risk and survival plot do not match.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Corrected all data inconsistencies and unified cutoff methodology.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Cut-off defined by median — differs between cohorts. Should define absolute risk value universally usable between cohorts. This would allow total evaluation across all cohorts and be very useful for implementation.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added absolute cutoff analysis derived from training set and applied uniformly.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Authors claim system can inform strategies for adjuvant therapy but provide no evidence of therapeutic significance.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Toned down therapeutic claims and framed as hypothesis-generating.

reviewer_strengths.text: Well-written analysis of a novel progression prediction algorithm for pRCC. Concentrates on an underserved cancer type, combining clinical, histopathologic, and lncRNA data.
